references.text: The hill country of Ephraim is also mentioned in Joshua as part of Israel's territory, indicating the geographical location of Micah's home.
The hill country of Ephraim is noted as an important region during the time of Joshua, the same area where Micah lived.
The hill country of Ephraim is mentioned in connection with Ehud and the gathering of the Israelites, the same geographical region from which Micah came.
The Danites came to Micah's house in the hill country of Ephraim, continuing the story of Micah from chapter 17.
The Danites traveled to the hill country of Ephraim to Micah's house, a direct continuation of the narrative that begins in this verse.
A similar opening formula with a man from the hill country of Ephraim, showing a literary pattern during the period of the judges and the early monarchy.
